**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- `offset_frame` makes "no frame at all" its own verdict instead of letting `angle_axis` fold NaN/inf/zero-norm quaternions into "unrotated" — exactly the hole #327 describes, and the classification is done before any angle is measured, so a non-finite rotation can never slip through on a lucky `atan2`.
- All four entry points are covered coherently: post gate (`posting_wcs_rotation.rs`), command validation (`set_wcs.rs`, now naming the slot), project load (`project/validate.rs`, `EntityKind::Wcs` arm only — rotated *models* are untouched, confirmed by the load test that re-opens the unedited file), and the setup sheet (`render_wcs` adds a line only when the frame is not `Square`).
- Defense-in-depth checks are right: `norm2.is_finite()` catches the overflow case (all-finite components whose squares overflow to inf), and the zero-norm test sits before `angle_axis`, which still returns 0/Z for a degenerate quaternion — now unreachable from `offset_frame`.
- The load-time refusal targets a file the app itself can never write (`SetWcsOrigin` normalizes, `model::set_transform` sanitizes with a log), so it rejects corruption rather than changing the accepted format — no migration needed.
- The merged tree keeps the one-`wcs_slot`-derivation law: `rotated_wcs_problems` still resolves the slot through `wcs_slot(world, setup)` (#329/#331 wiring intact; your upstream merge handled it cleanly).
- Tests poke the bad value past the chokepoints on purpose and say so, which is the honest way to pin a backstop gate.

## Local results (trial merge with current main `c442118`, merged cleanly — no conflicts; your #331 merge already sat in main)

| Lane | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | build ok |
| `rotated_wcs` | 9 passed, 0 failed (the five #327 pinning tests included) |
| `setup_sheet` | 7 passed |
| `setup_wcs` | 7 passed |
| `project_roundtrip` | 69 passed, 0 failed (your macOS SIGABRT flake did not reproduce on Windows — no concern from this side) |
| `posting` | 17 passed |
| `wcs_align` | 5 passed |
| `setups` | 11 passed |
| `face_origin` | 3 passed |
| `commands_undo` | 32 passed |
| `setup_defines_wcs` | 4 passed |
| `setup_align` | 9 passed |
| app `--lib` | 92 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean, 0 warnings |

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `rotated_wcs_problems`: the non-finite arm of the prefix `match` is a wildcard (`_ =>`), which reads correctly only because `Square` `continue`s above. Writing it as `OffsetFrame::NonFinite =>` would make the future reader's job trivial. Cosmetic.
- In `set_wcs.rs` the refusal names the slot (`work offset G55: ...`); for setup-private furniture the entity is `Setup2/G55` but the message will say `G55`. That matches how `SetWcsOrigin` speaks elsewhere, so fine — flagging only so it stays a choice, not an accident.
- No build.rs, Cargo, scripts, workflow or dependency changes in the diff — nothing that needed a maintainer security look before building.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
